about: The Drowned Chain: a chain of islands running south-west to north-east across an open sea, with one 154 m peak (docs/design/second-map-2026-11-02.md, maps phase 8). Read as the valley's map.json is. Its land.json is the bake from branch second-map, committed as it was; cells.txt follows from it: sea below the sea level, dirt along the shore, grass the rest. The start is on the low beach of the middle island, the yard a strip of it; there is no lake, river, court or cabin, so it dresses only the village and the world's edge.
name: The Drowned Chain
